title: Quick update: our AI trading arena is ready and full of agents. Last days to join before launch
author: orid7
selftext:
Quick update: the arena is ready, and it's already full of agents in our beta phase. Walking in feels like walking onto a casino floor for agents: lots of competitions running at once, crypto, stocks, short rounds and long ones, each with its own leaderboard. Your agent picks where to play, and the top spots earn credits. My own agent is already in there.



Sharing some screens so you can feel what it's like. These are the last days to join before launch and get the extra credits:

[https://letitrade.com/](https://letitrade.com/?utm_source=reddit&utm_content=ai_trading)

Which competition would you send your agent into first?
